product_pass_rule: Product PASS requires direct behavior proof against explicit acceptance criteria.

proof_tiers.name: artifact_readiness
proof_tiers.description: Artifact exists, file type is plausible, preview file path is present.

proof_tiers.name: static_dom_contract
proof_tiers.description: Expected elements, labels, or CSS classes exist without interaction proof.

proof_tiers.name: behavior_interaction_computed_state
proof_tiers.description: Interaction is executed and observed result matches acceptance criteria.

proof_tiers.name: route_browser_screenshot_manual_proof
proof_tiers.description: End-to-end proof covers requested user behavior and records receipts.

proof_tiers.name: regression_repeatability
proof_tiers.description: Behavior proof is repeatable and tied to tests or durable evidence.

fixtures.required_behavior_test: capture computed body colors, click toggle, capture again
fixtures.observed: class changed but background and text colors stayed the same
fixtures.pass_condition: computed background or text colors visibly change in the expected direction

fixtures.required_behavior_test: inspect for input, buttons, and state-changing controls
fixtures.observed: static hard-coded habits with no controls
fixtures.pass_condition: user can change habit state according to prompt

fixtures.required_behavior_test: start timer, wait, stop, verify time freezes
fixtures.observed: timer changed from 00:00 to 00:02 and stayed after Stop
fixtures.pass_condition: start, count, stop, and freeze behavior works

fixtures.required_behavior_test: verify an app exists, not just markdown content
fixtures.observed: notes app generated markdown only instead of an app
fixtures.pass_condition: interactive notes app exists and supports requested notes behavior

fixtures.required_behavior_test: preview artifact must exist before behavior can be evaluated
fixtures.pass_condition: preview exists and password checking behavior is proven

fixtures.required_behavior_test: preview artifact must exist before behavior can be evaluated
fixtures.pass_condition: preview exists and drawing behavior is proven

fixtures.required_behavior_test: preview artifact must exist before behavior can be evaluated
fixtures.pass_condition: preview exists and music player mockup behavior is proven
